reviews.title: Return process
reviews.text: I’m really disappointed with this online app. Returning items is a nightmare — the process is slow, and feels intentionally difficult. Customer service isn’t any better; responses take forever, and you don’t get clear help when you finally hear back. Overall, a very frustrating experience. I won’t be ordering again.
